flows.name: reading
flows.about: A script collects new items about my chosen topics from a gardening feed into the daily note; I read them and pick something to try. Once a week I look at the summary and change which topics the feed collects.
edges: notes/daily/{date}.md#Reading -> [me] Read and pick something to try
[me] Read and pick something to try -> notes/daily/{date}.md#Tasks
[me] Read and pick something to try -> notes/ideas.md
summary/weekly.md -> [me] Review the week and change what to collect -> scripts/feed_topics.json

loops.name: Do not show the same item twice
The Reading section is rewritten in place
Reading becomes tasks
nodes: [me] Read and pick something to try

loops.name: The weekly review changes what the feed collects
nodes: [me] Review the week and change what to collect

flows.name: weekly
flows.about: A script summarises the week; I plan the next one from it, and an AI assistant suggests ideas. The AI's ideas feeding the next summary is left undeclared on purpose: build reports it as an unnamed loop. The statistics file nobody reads is also left on purpose: build reports it as a dead end.
edges: summary/weekly.md -> [AI] Suggest ideas from the week
[AI] Suggest ideas from the week -> notes/ideas.md

loops.name: Next week's tasks come from this week's summary
